rows.en: I see… As expected of General Volcano Mask!
Surface, quickly!
We've got no choice but to dive the machines in, huh?

Right, the three of us will surround the Navaron!

Ao, you take the power room on the right… Mido, the weapons depot on the left. I'll go for the command room from behind!

Signal once you're right up against the Navaron!
Got it!
We'll blow up the machines along with these bombs! Let's go!
Right, the command room!
Found the power room!
So this is the weapons depot?
Okay, now!
Right, get out!
Right, the command room!
Found the power room!
So this is the weapons depot?
Okay, now!
Right, escape with the Birdie!

Nuoh! Gh… Ghuu… Nuooh!

Blast it! Did you think something like this would kill me!?
You're still alive, Volcano Mask!?
I cannot die until I've sent you all to hell! …Nu!?
Ain't gonna let you!
All five of us together…
Nngh… Attack!
Hoi hoi! Hoi hoi!
Mr. Oiwa! Mr. Tachibana said to collect on your tab!
Now ain't the time for that!
I suppose that's true…
Yeah, that's true…

I'll pay once we beat Volcano Mask…

Probably… maybe?
Heh heh heh… Then I'll make sure you can never pay it in your life!

What's this? An egg? Can't eat it raw, I'll boil it!

Heh heh heh… Looks tasty! I'll gobble it up!

Uwaaaah… How humiliatiiing!
Awaken, Great General! The time has come…
I have awoken from a long, long sleep…
Golden Mask Great General…

I have risen…

I swear upon the Black Cross… I will crush the Gorenger! Without fail…
Black Cross Fuhrer… Humble though our strength may be, our battle fleet nation Naager will lend you our aid.
Mm… Gorenger! Learn the power of the Black Cross Army!
Sacrificing their Star Machines, the Gorenger destroyed the mobile fortress Navaron! But this does not mean the threat of the Black Cross Army has vanished…
Unite your five powers into one and protect the world, Gorengeeer!
Uoooooh…
Uwaaaah…
Leave it to meee! …Or so I thought…
Kyaaaah…!
Defeat all Zolder Soldiers and the Black Cross Ninja Corps!
Defeat all Zolder Soldiers and the Black Cross Ninja Corps, and take down the mobile fortress Navaron!
Defeat Volcano Mask General Magman, all Zolder Soldiers and the Black Cross Ninja Corps!
Tsuyoshi Kaijo, Akira Shinmei or Kenji Asuka is defeated
Report from the undersea base! That thing is finished. Please look at the footage.

Oh… Magnificent work!

Just what I'd expect from something our undersea base built with all its might…

This robot is my life, my hope! I name it King Deviler!

King Deviler surpasses Red Baron in every respect!

The Hammer Punch, which can smash even steel… and its greatest weapon, the Head Guillotine mounted on its head.

Red Baron took heavy damage in the battle with the Space Fortress Naager…

If we attack, it's now! If we're to defeat it, it's now! Prepare a surprise attack!
Huh… So this is that wristwatch?
That's right! Red Baron's Seven Secrets are in my hands, you see.
Seven Secrets?
Yeah… The plan to upgrade and remodel Red Baron.
The blueprints for that are inside the wristwatch?
Amazing, right? Once it's done, Iron Mask Party or Naager, we'll have nothing to fear!

Daisaku, you're talking too much! That loose mouth of yours is a bad habit…

SSI secrets are never supposed to leak out, remember?
Mari, don't be so uptight! The people here aren't SSI, but they're our friends, aren't they!?
Well, that's true, but…
But a mission is a mission! Mari is right.

That's right… The walls have ears, and the paper screens have eyes, as they say.

Sometimes the lesson of "see no evil, speak no evil, hear no evil" is the best self-defense there is… Especially when you're walking around carrying something that important.
Yes, sir, I'll be careful…
But… that space fortress is getting closer to Earth! From now on we can't let our guard down for a single day.
Meaning what? Something else is going to happen?
Right… Isn't it about time for it to show up?
…Wh-what is it? All of you… why are you looking at me like that?

See? Just like I said, right?

So, Taki… what's happened this time?
Ah… well, um…
Ah, now I remember!
Iron Mask Party robots are running wild. Looks like a surprise attack.
Damn, it's Deviler! Mari, let's go!
Right!
All right, you lot go too! But be careful!
Ken, can you hear me!? Ken…!
Yes, Ken here…

Iron Mask Party robots have launched a surprise attack! You should be near them!

But… Red Baron is in the middle of its upgrade! Buy us some time with Operation Shadow!
Understood! I'll try.
So you've come out, Red Baron… Today I'll settle things once and for all! Go, King Deviler!
Fight Lever, on!
It's Red Baron… So that's the Iron Mask Party robot?
